title: Hoshino Ichika — I Have To Act On My Own〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: I Have To Act On My Own（2★）

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... SpoJoy Park's supposed to be near the station... So it should be this way, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that's also what the map on their website says.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I can't wait to get there!
I've actually kinda been interested in checking it out for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Really?
I walk by the station sometimes but didn't know about it at all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's not supposed to be like a gym or anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it's more fun than that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(How does Minori do it...?
It's like she, Kanade and Ena are already good friends.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I finally got to meet Kanade again, so I'd like to talk more with her about her group, songwriting and tell her more about the shows we've been doing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They've paused for a bit. Now's my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I get to hang out with an idol today. Mizuki's gonna be so jealous.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh...
I missed my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki got all googly-eyed when we got to hang out to Airi and Shizuku that one time too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't know that, but I can definitely empathize! I mean, Airi and Shizuku have these amazingly sparkly auras about them!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Ena, didn't you say you've known them since junior high school...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Airi, yes.
She later introduced me to Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry about that.
You probably don't know who I'm talking about, huh, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, um... It's okay...
Actually, they're a year above me at school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, they are, aren't they?
Being idols and all, are they pretty popular at school?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, they are. So popular that everybody lines up to give them presents for their birthdays and such.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wow, that's astounding.
Have you ever given them gifts before, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I've known Shizuku since I was little and one of my childhood friends is a big fan of Momoi, so we go greet them together sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. I'm still having a hard time imagining what it'd be like to have idols going to the same school as me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I feel that's pretty normal!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I... I finally got to say something...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I wouldn't have been able to if Ena didn't toss me a question...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Also, when I went out to eat with Kanade the other day, I felt like Honami and Asahina had to direct the conversation in order for me to say anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I still can't do much on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But we're here, so I can't let things continue like this. I need to take advantage of this opportunity and actually talk to her!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: K-Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... I hope today goes well!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Go well...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, so... In terms of getting in some good exercise!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Yes, I hope so too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: G-Great!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also... I really liked that song you were singing earlier.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Would you mind if I asked you to elaborate more?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't get to hear all of it, so I can only talk about the parts that I did hear. Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The lyrics were very easy to digest and I could feel myself being immersed into your song's world.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The melody also had a cool feel to it, which your performance matched very well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The solo version you played was nice, so I'm curious as to what it sounds like when you play it as a band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I couldn't be happier to hear you say that, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Thank goodness... I got to talk to her a little.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And I got to hear what she thought of my street performance... That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ichika! Kanade!
I think I see SpoJoy Park!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Minori and Ena have gone so far ahead...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We must've been walking slower than we realized.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You may be right.
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I hope we get to talk more about the things we haven't been able to touch on while exercising at SpoJoy Park.)
